The fundus photograph shows a small dark blue-purple round spot at the macular region with a pale hazy area around it and the optic disc at the right side. The OCT B-scan shows a dome-like elevation of the layered retina with a darker rounded region beneath it; the sector grid and table cells carry pink coloring, and the thickness profile plot has a pink background band.  Text "TrueColor" and "CENTERVUE EIDON" is printed at the lower left and lower right of the fundus photograph. Right of the fundus photograph are optical coherence tomography printouts with Polish-language headings such as "Mapa istotności siatkówki" or "Grubość siatkówki", a circular sector grid with small printed numbers, a small table headed "Pomiary ILM - OS/RPE" with rows such as "Centralny sektor [µm]" and "Objętość [mm³]", a gray B-scan with a "200 µm" scale bar and a frame counter in its upper right corner, a thickness profile plot, and colored maps on the right. The small numbers inside the grids and table are printed pixel content and are not transcribed.

panels.general_description: Panel C: color fundus photograph at left with optical coherence tomography printouts at right. The fundus photograph shows a small dark red-brown spot with scattered yellowish dots around it.
panels.detailed_description: Panel C has the printed letter "C" in a white box at the upper left of a round color fundus photograph with a black surround. The fundus photograph shows a small dark red-brown spot with scattered yellowish dots around it. The OCT B-scan shows a shallow contour with a vertical dark shadow beneath it; the thickness map is mostly green with a blue center, and the sector grid is green with one red cell.  Text "TrueColor" and "CENTERVUE EIDON" is printed at the lower left and lower right of the fundus photograph. Right of the fundus photograph are optical coherence tomography printouts with Polish-language headings such as "Mapa istotności siatkówki" or "Grubość siatkówki", a circular sector grid with small printed numbers, a small table headed "Pomiary ILM - OS/RPE" with rows such as "Centralny sektor [µm]" and "Objętość [mm³]", a gray B-scan with a "200 µm" scale bar and a frame counter in its upper right corner, a thickness profile plot, and colored maps on the right. The small numbers inside the grids and table are printed pixel content and are not transcribed.
